## R configuration

`setup_default_Maturity()` creates maturity parameter rows in the high-level
parameter tibble. `initialize_fims()` serializes these rows and the model data
without constructing native modules or starting Julia.

`R/julia_backend.R` maps maturity inflection points and slopes into Julia
components and their fixed/random estimation masks. Parameter ordering is
explicit and must not rely on dictionary iteration.

## Julia evaluation

The Julia backend lives in `inst/julia/FIMSBackend`. Its maturity module evaluates
logistic maturity, and the population module uses maturity in spawning biomass.
The objective and optimizer evaluate the same population report used by the R
bridge. Julia automatic differentiation propagates maturity parameter changes
through likelihoods and uncertainty calculations.

## R output and tests

`R/fimsfit.R` adapts Julia reports and parameter estimates to `FIMSFit` output.
`get_report()` includes proportions mature at age; `get_estimates()` exposes
parameter and derived-quantity estimates with uncertainty when available.

Extend `inst/julia/FIMSBackend/test/runtests.jl` for numerical behavior and
`tests/testthat/test-julia-backend.R` for serialization and real bridge coverage.
Mocked bridge tests verify wiring only, not model numerics.
